content: We Work Remotely: Remote jobs in design, programming, marketing and more https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs.rss We Work Remotely: Remote jobs in design, programming, marketing and more en-US 60 SuperPlane: Product Engineer Anywhere in the World Delaware GoLang, React, CI/CD Pipelines, and AI Agents Full-Stack Programming Full-Time <img src="https://we-work-remotely.imgix.net/logos/0171/4898/logo.gif?ixlib=rails-4.0.0&w=50&h=50&dpr=2&fit=fill&auto=compress" /> <p> <strong>Headquarters:</strong> USA <br /><strong>URL:</strong> <a href="https://superplane.com">https://superplane.com</a> </p> <p>We are hiring a product engineer to join SuperPlane and own meaningful projects end to end.</p> <p>This is a remote role. We currently work across GMT+2 to GMT-3 and welcome candidates in that range.</p> <p>At SuperPlane, we don't split engineering into frontend and backend. Everyone is a well-rounded builder who moves across the stack, makes product and technical calls, asks for help when needed, and delivers features from start to finish. You might spend one day building an API endpoint or workflow engine improvement, and the next day polishing a React surface that users touch every day.</p> <p>We're looking for someone at a mid-level to senior level: you've shipped real products, you can work independently, and you're ready to grow fast in a high-trust, high-pace environment. You don't need to have done everything before, but you need to learn quickly and take ownership of what you build.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <h2>What We Are Looking For</h2> <ul> <li> <p>You are genuinely full-stack.</p> </li> <li> <p>Your workflow is AI-driven and you know how to stay fast without getting sloppy.</p> </li> <li> <p>You have strong backend experience in a systems-oriented language. While we use Go, we don't expect you to be an expert already, just to ramp up fast.</p> </li> <li> <p>You have solid systems judgment. APIs, data models, reliability, and trade-offs matter to you.</p> </li> <li> <p>You're comfortable with TypeScript and React -- the modern frontend stack.</p> </li> <li> <p>You are comfortable with cloud-native tooling and modern software delivery.</p> </li> <li> <p>You want ownership, not a narrow lane.</p> </li> <li> <p>You want an early-stage company where the pace is high, the standards are high, and the upside is big.</p> </li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <h2>How To Apply</h2> <p>We care more about proof of work than polished applications, and we want to see how you show up in open source.</p> <p>Before you apply, submit at least one pull request to superplanehq/superplane. It can be small and it does not need to be merged.</p> <p>When you apply, send your GitHub username and a link to your pull request. We verify both, and applications missing either field will not move forward.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <h2>Why You'll Love Working at SuperPlane</h2> <ul> <li> <p>Build a frontier product used by engineers across the globe.</p> </li> <li> <p>Meaningful equity and real ownership.</p> </li> <li> <p>Small team, fast feedback loops.</p> </li> <li> <p>Remote role that lets you focus and create.</p> </li> </ul> <p><strong>To apply:</strong> <a href="https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/superplane-product-engineer-1">https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/superplane-product-engineer-1</a></p> Fri, 31 Jul 2026 13:30:28 +0000 Sun, 30 Aug 2026 13:30:28 +0000 https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/superplane-product-engineer-1 https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/superplane-product-engineer-1 Hygraph: Senior Fullstack Engineer (f/m/d) - Berlin I Germany, EMEA I Remote Anywhere in the World 🇨🇿 Czechia, 🇩🇪 Germany, 🇪🇸 Spain, 🇬🇷 Greece, 🇭🇷 Croatia, 🇰🇪 Kenya, 🇲🇰 North Macedonia, 🇳🇬 Nigeria, 🇵🇱 Poland, 🇵🇹 Portugal, 🇷🇴 Romania, 🇷🇸 Serbia, and 🇿🇦 South Africa Berlin Full-Stack Programming Full-Time <img src="https://we-work-remotely.imgix.net/logos/0083/7765/logo.gif?ixlib=rails-4.0.0&w=50&h=50&dpr=2&fit=fill&auto=compress" /> <p> <strong>Headquarters:</strong> Dircksenstraße 47, 10178 Berlin, Germany <br /><strong>URL:</strong> <a href="https://hygraph.com">https://hygraph.com</a> </p> <div class="sc-1fwbcuw-0 jBXtP"> <div> <p><strong>How will you make an impact?</strong></p> <p>As a Senior Full Stack Engineer, you'll work at the intersection of engineering and product to shape how our users build with Hygraph. You won't wait for perfect specs or pixel-perfect designs. You'll use your judgment, collaborate closely with product managers, designers, and customers, and move fast using modern AI-assisted development tools.</p> <p>This role is for someone who sees engineering as a team sport, takes ownership without waiting for permission, and thrives in an environment where initiative matters more than instructions.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>What you will be working on:</strong></p> <ul> <li> <p>Core CMS development: Evolve the GraphQL-native CMS powering enterprise teams worldwide, improving performance, reliability, and developer experience.</p> </li> <li> <p>CMS extensions and integrations: Develop and maintain extensions that expand what customers can do with Hygraph.</p> </li> <li> <p>AI-powered features: Contribute to our AI roadmap by building intelligent capabilities into the product.</p> </li> <li> <p>Customer-facing improvements: Use monitoring data, customer feedback, and your product instinct to identify and fix problems before they're reported proactively.</p> </li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Some of your tasks and responsibilities:</strong></p> <ul> <li> <p>Collaborate in a cross-functional, autonomous team to deliver features and continuous improvements, often working from rough prototypes or early concepts rather than polished designs.</p> </li> <li> <p>Translate business needs into technical solutions by working closely with the Product team. Occasionally, participate in customer conversations to validate that what you're building actually solves their problems.</p> </li> <li> <p>Comfortable using modern AI-assisted development tools (Cursor, Claude, Codex, or similar) to accelerate development.</p> </li> <li> <p>Proactively identify issues through monitoring and observability data. Then fix them, don't just flag them.</p> </li> <li> <p>Contribute to architectural decisions that keep our platform scalable, reliable, and maintainable.</p> </li> <li> <p>Share what you know, learn from others, and help your teammates grow.
